name: edit_wan3_video
description: Dry-run preview of Alibaba Model Studio Wan 3 editing. The preview licence allows only internal testing, research and evaluation, so customer live requests are blocked even with approval. Requires video_url, prompt, measured source_duration_seconds and source_fps. Default duration=-1 has unknown cost; explicit total output seconds quote input plus output. Outputs are not training eligible. A preview is not generated media.

video_url.description: Public HTTP(S) MP4/MOV source video URL without embedded credentials. Exactly one reference video is supported.

prompt.description: Edit or extend instruction. The adapter adds the required Video 1 intent to the prompt.

source_duration_seconds.description: Actual measured input video seconds from 1 to 15. Input seconds also incur cost; local field.

source_fps.description: Actual measured source frame rate, at least 16 fps; local field.

duration.description: Total output seconds from 2 to 30. Input plus output must be at most 30. Default -1 is smart duration with unknown cost, dry-run only. Extension output must exceed the source duration.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to 10 public image references. No unpublished image input charge.

reference_audio_urls.description: Up to 5 public audio references totaling at most 15 seconds. Voice references require likeness_consent=true.

reference_audio_durations.description: Measured positive seconds for each audio reference, in matching order; local field.

real_face_refs.description: True when the source or references contain a real person's likeness; requires likeness_consent=true.

likeness_consent.description: Acknowledge the rights and consent for all referenced real likenesses and voices; local field.

name: extend_wan3_video
description: Dry-run preview of Alibaba Model Studio Wan 3 extension. Customer live use is blocked by its internal-evaluation preview licence, which spending approval cannot override. duration is TOTAL output length: a 5s source extended by 2s uses duration=7 and bills 12s. Default -1 has unknown cost. Uses adaptive ratio and prompt-based direction. Outputs are not training eligible.

prompt.description: Edit or extend instruction. The adapter adds the required Video 1 intent to the prompt.

direction.description: Extend forward, backward, or both. Adds prompt text only; never a wire parameter.

name: get_task
description: Inspect a saved Model Studio task or dry-run handle without submitting work. Preview licensing currently blocks live task polling. In a permitted future workflow, download=true persists a completed MP4 and provenance. Reuse saved jobs instead of resubmitting; previews are not generated media.

job_id.description: Exact task UUID returned by a submit tool. Poll once per call; this never submits video work.

download.description: Save completed MP4 and provenance under RENDERHAUS_MEDIA_DIR. Defaults to true; cached downloads are reused.
